title: Software Engineer III - Java Fullstack, React, AWS, Microservices
description:
**Job Description**
We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Auto Finance you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.

* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
* Full-Stack Feature Delivery: Design, build, and deploy high-performance web applications using React for the front end and Java for the back end.
* API & Microservices Architecture: Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs and microservices in Java

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Front-End Mastery: Extensive experience with React.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend build tools.
* Back-End Expertise: Robust background in Java, including framework proficiency with Spring Boot, Spring Security, and Hibernate
* AI & Engineering Acumen: Proven experience connecting applications to AI APIs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, or working with orchestration frameworks
* Data Systems: Experience designing schemas for both traditional relational SQL/NoSQL databases and vector search indexing. Soft Skills & Collaboration: Agile/Scrum/Kanban team experience, Git version control expertise, and a passion for staying on the cutting edge of AI advancements
* Understanding of application resiliency. Proficiency in automation and continuous delivery methods. Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle. Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security.
* Demonstrated proficiency in software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.). Emerging knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Familiarity with modern front-end technologies
* Exposure to Python

title: Senior Application Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience developing and supporting scalable, highly available services.
* Proficiency in Java and C#/.NET, with experience building REST APIs and backend services.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of networking protocols, including TCP/IP and HTTP.
* Experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL, and database-backed applications.
* Familiarity with Linux, debugging, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
* Ability to develop and test control plane capabilities for database provisioning, lifecycle management, and service orchestration.
* Experience with cloud platforms, multi-tenant services, or open-source contributions is a plus.

**Career Level: IC3**
**Responsibilities**
As a Software Engineer (IC3), you will develop and operate the OCI PostgreSQL Control Plane using Java. You will work within established architectures to build features and services, troubleshoot issues, and improve service reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with senior engineers, architects, and product stakeholders to design and deliver features.
* Build and maintain backend APIs and workflows for database provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform to provision, configure, and manage OCI resources.
* Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews, automated testing, and design discussions.
* Investigate production issues, implement fixes, and improve monitoring and operational procedures.
* Support customer onboarding and resolve technical issues in collaboration with partner teams.
* Participate in a rotating on-call schedule.
* Identify and implement improvements to service performance, availability, usability, and cost efficiency.

**Top Four Skills For The Ideal Candidate**

* Strong coding and debugging skills in Java and C#/.NET.
* Solid software engineering fundamentals and experience developing distributed backend services.
* Practical experience with databases, REST APIs, Linux, and cloud environments.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with ownership of assigned work.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with typically 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience. Advanced degrees with relevant experience are also welcome.

title: Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer within Corporate Fraud, you will contribute to the design of, and build, test and support, secure, resilient and scalable services that enable real-time and batch fraud detection across corporate banking payment channels. You will work closely with product owners, business analysts, test engineers, architects and platform teams to deliver change across the Corporate Fraud technology estate.
  
  
**To be successful as a Software Engineer, you should have experience with:**

* Hands-on software engineering using Java, including modern Java features, object-oriented design, collections, exception handling, concurrency and unit testing.
* Development of enterprise services using Spring Boot, microservices and REST APIs, with practical experience of API design, implementation, integration and support.
* Working with event-driven and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and AWS services including SQS, S3 and RDS.
* Working with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including data modelling, SQL, performance optimisation and reliable data access patterns.
* Containerisation and cloud-native delivery using Docker and AWS, with an understanding of deployment, runtime resilience, observability and production support.
* Continuous integration and continuous delivery using GitLab CI/CD, source control and automated quality gates.
* Writing and maintaining automated unit, API and integration tests, with a focus on maintainability and effective test coverage.
* End-to-end Agile delivery using Jira and Confluence, including refinement of technical requirements, estimation, implementation, peer review and support through testing and release.

**Some Of Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Experience with NICE Actimize, including IFMX/FPP, ActOne or related fraud-detection capabilities.
* Knowledge of corporate banking or wholesale banking, fraud detection and the attended and unattended payment-channel landscape.
* Knowledge of ISO 20022 and other payment-messaging formats, payment processing patterns and high-value/high-volume payment flows.
* Experience of re-platforming, migration, data-driven back-end programmes and integration with third-party SaaS products.
* Experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS EKS/ECS, CloudWatch, Splunk, Jenkins, Postman or comparable engineering and operational tooling.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The location of the role is Pune, IN.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer (SDE II) || Altera Institute - Digiaccel Learning**

At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to redefine management education for the digital and AI-first world. We are building technology that powers transformative learning experiences for thousands of learners across India. From learner journeys and assessments to AI-enabled learning experiences and internal platforms, our engineering team plays a critical role in shaping the future of education.

As a Senior Software Engineer II (SDE II), you will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling high-performance web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. You will work across the full technology stack, collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Business teams, and take ownership of key product initiatives from ideation to deployment.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, writing clean and scalable code, and building products that create meaningful impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Full Stack Development & Product Engineering**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, Nest.js).
* Build reusable, modular, and high-quality components that enhance application performance and maintainability.
* Translate business requirements and product specifications into elegant technical solutions.
* Own features end-to-end—from technical design and development to deployment and post-release monitoring.

**Engineering Excellence & Architecture**

* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to engineering best practices and coding standards.
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions that improve scalability and reliability.
* Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and help maintain a high engineering quality bar across the team.
* Continuously improve application performance, security, and overall system reliability.

**Collaboration & Cross-Functional Execution**

* Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and fellow Engineers to define, prioritize, and deliver product features.
* Collaborate with QA teams to ensure high-quality releases through effective testing and validation.
* Support technical discussions, sprint planning, and estimation activities within the engineering team.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to fostering a collaborative engineering culture.

**Performance Optimization & Problem Solving**

* Identify bottlenecks and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and responsiveness.
* Troubleshoot production issues, debug complex technical problems, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Monitor application health and proactively improve system stability and user experience.

**Quality, Testing & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure application reliability.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for applications, APIs, and engineering processes.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices, driving continuous improvements within the engineering team.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3-5 years of experience in full-stack software development using the MERN stack.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong proficiency in MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, NestJS and Node.js.
* Experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web development
* Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
* Exposure to Docker, cloud platforms (AWS preferred), CI/CD pipelines, or containerized deployments is desirable.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering scalable solutions.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Build Products That Matter -**
  Create technology that impacts the learning journeys and careers of thousands of professionals.
* **Engineering with Ownership -**
  Work on challenging product problems where your ideas and technical decisions have meaningful influence.
* **High-Growth Environment -**
  Be part of a fast-scaling organization that values innovation, speed, and engineering excellence.
* **Continuous Learning -**
  Work alongside experienced product and engineering leaders while continuously expanding your technical expertise.
* **Collaborative Culture -**
  Join a team that believes in transparency, ownership, intellectual honesty, and continuous improvement.

**About the Company**

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift inthe skills ecosystemat the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA studentsfrom legacy institutes who are unplacedand professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors.

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a youngcompany and each role has the abilityto make a largeimpact. We can assure of a very talent dense,intellectually honest, actionoriented and collaborative environment.

We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

Office

**Job Title: ServiceNow Developer**

**Experience: 3+ years**

**Purpose of the Role
﻿**

The ServiceNow Developer is responsible for designing, configuring, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise-grade solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

This role requires a ServiceNow developer who can operate effectively in a larger, governed IT organization, where platform architecture standards, security requirements, documentation, testing, release management, and operational readiness are expected parts of delivery. The individual should be comfortable working within structured development processes while also using approved AI-enabled tools to accelerate scripting, improve quality, support testing, and enhance code reviews.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on ServiceNow configuration and development, disciplined SDLC execution, AI-assisted development practices, and strong collaboration with product, architecture, security, infrastructure, platform, and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. ServiceNow Configuration and Development**

· Configure, customize, and develop within the ServiceNow platform to support enterprise business processes.

· Build and maintain ServiceNow workflows, flows, forms, tables, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, catalog items, integrations, and automation.

· Support ServiceNow modules and capabilities as assigned, including ITSM, ITOM, HAM, SAM, Employee Relations, Employee Journeys, or other platform areas.

· Develop integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, web services, or other approved integration methods.

· Ensure ServiceNow development follows platform best practices, upgrade-safe configuration principles, and enterprise governance standards.

· Partner with ServiceNow administrators, platform owners, process owners, and business stakeholders to deliver practical and sustainable solutions.

**2. AI-Assisted Development, Testing, and Code Review**

· Use approved AI development tools responsibly to accelerate ServiceNow scripting, configuration analysis, documentation, test generation, troubleshooting, and solution design.

· Apply AI tools as an enhancement to technical judgment, not as a replacement for developer accountability.

· Use approved AI tools to identify ServiceNow test scenarios, strengthen regression coverage, and document potential gaps that require developer validation.

· Participate in AI-assisted review of ServiceNow scripts and configurations while validating outputs for accuracy, security, maintainability, and compliance with enterprise standards.

· Maintain traceability for AI-assisted work by documenting how generated scripts, configurations, and test assets were reviewed and approved through established development and governance processes.

· Stay current on approved AI development practices, emerging capabilities, and responsible-use guidelines.

**3. Governance, Architecture, and Enterprise Standards**

· Work within established enterprise architecture, security, data, and development governance processes.

· Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with approved technology patterns.

· Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and governance checkpoints as needed.

· Document technical designs, configuration decisions, integration patterns, dependencies, and operational considerations.

· Avoid unnecessary technical debt, duplication, unsupported customization, and one-off solutions that conflict with enterprise standards.

· Incorporate feedback from architecture, security, infrastructure, and platform governance teams early in the delivery process.

**4. SDLC, Agile, and Delivery Discipline**

· Participate in agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.

· Develop against clearly defined acceptance criteria and ensure work is fully tested before release.

· Support release management activities including deployment planning, change documentation, validation, and post-release support.

· Identify technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and readiness concerns early.

· Communicate progress, issues, and trade-offs clearly to technical leads, product owners, and project stakeholders.

· Understand that “code complete” does not mean “ready for production”; testing, documentation, support readiness, and operational handoff are part of delivery.

**5. Testing, Quality, and Operational Readiness**

· Create and execute ServiceNow unit tests, configuration validation, integration tests, and developer-level platform validation.

· Support QA, UAT, regression testing, and production validation activities.

· Use AI and automation tools where appropriate to improve test coverage and development efficiency.

· Troubleshoot production issues and support root cause analysis.

· Ensure solutions include appropriate logging, monitoring considerations, error handling, and support documentation.

· Partner with support and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions can be successfully operated after go-live.

**6. Collaboration and Business Alignment**

· Work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, platform owners, and technical teams to understand desired outcomes.

· Ask clarifying questions to ensure requirements are complete, practical, and aligned with enterprise direction.

· Provide technical input on feasibility, complexity, sequencing, and risk.

· Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Help identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate manual work, improve user experience, and reduce operational friction.

· Act as a responsible technical partner who understands both business needs and enterprise technology constraints.

**Role Boundaries**

**· This is a hands-on ServiceNow development role, not an administrator-only position.**

**Required ServiceNow Experience**

· 2+ years of hands-on experience configuring or developing within the ServiceNow platform.

· Experience with ServiceNow scripting, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, flows, forms, tables, catalog items, and workflow automation.

The Techno-Functional Analyst, Supply Chain Systems supports, enhances, and optimize systems used for Global Supply Chain Management (SCM) operations. Working closely with the GSCM team, business stakeholders, internal, and external service providers, the Techno-Functional Analyst helps analyze operational needs, document requirements, configure approved system changes, test enhancements, troubleshoot issues, maintain accurate system data, and delivers scalable business solutions. **SCM Technical & Functional Support**

* Analyze business requirements and design end-to-end business, process, data, and technology solutions that improve organizational effectiveness and user experience.
* Configure, support, and optimize SCM modules and technologies, including procurement, purchasing, inventory management, costing, and supplier management.

* Coordinate with software vendors, implementation partners, and support providers to resolve issues, manage enhancements, and ensure service quality.

* Facilitate prioritization of enhancement requests, projects, and operational support activities.
* Develop and maintain the capability of roadmaps aligned with functional goals and organizational priorities.

* Contributes to cross-functional projects and initiatives, influencing decisions and driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders.
* Contribute to strategic planning, budgeting, roadmap development, and platform lifecycle management.

No

**Job Title: Product Owner Digital (Web)**

**CTC: upto 45 to 50LPA**

**\\*\\*We are looking for a Techno-Functional Product Owner role that bridges real-estate customer journeys with end-to-end web architecture. Beyond owning roadmaps and backlogs, you will actively contribute to technical design discussions—covering frontend frameworks, backend services, REST APIs, database flows, and enterprise integrations—while guiding engineering teams and delivery partners on scalability, performance, and production\\*\\***

**Purpose:**

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner Digital (Web) to own the vision, product roadmap, backlog, and business outcomes for COMPANY's customer-facing websites and web portals. The role will shape web experiences for prospective property buyers, property owners, residents, sales prospects, and other key stakeholders across the real-estate lifecycle - from discovery, property research, enquiry, and sales conversion through onboarding, handover, ownership, community services, and ongoing engagement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Product Vision, Strategy and Roadmap:**

- Own the product vision, multi-year outcome-based roadmap, and OKRs across COMPANY's web estate (property websites, campaign/country microsites, corporate sites, and customer/resident portals) covering acquisition, conversion, self-service, reliability, and CSAT.

- Translate business strategy into product themes, release priorities, and investment proposals aligned with sales growth, lead quality, CX, owner engagement, and operational efficiency.

- Retain final accountability for roadmap prioritization, product value, and business acceptance while directing Cognizant and delivery partners within approved sprint and capacity plans.

- Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle—from discovery, validation, and launch to optimization, technical debt remediation, modernization, and retirement of legacy web capabilities—informed by analytics, market trends, risk, and regulatory needs.

**Real-Estate Customer Journey and Experience Ownership:**

- Own end-to-end UAE and international real-estate web journeys for buyers, investors, owners, and residents—spanning discovery, property search/comparison, lead capture, sales hand-off, reservations, onboarding, handover, payments, service requests, and community engagement.

- Partner with Sales, Marketing, CRM, Customer Happiness, Handover, Property/Community Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations to close journey gaps and maintain cross-channel consistency.

- Maintain personas, journey maps, and service blueprints validated through UX research, usability testing, and behavioral data.

- Ensure accurate, discoverable property, pricing, availability, and regulatory content while championing responsive design, accessibility, localization, SEO, and COMPANY brand standards.

**Demand, Backlog and Release Management:**

- Own the product backlog and maintain a transparent, prioritized pipeline of features, enhancements, defects, technical enablers, security remediation, content improvements, and operational fixes.

- Define high-quality epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, non-functional requirements, and expected outcomes in collaboration with business analysts, UX designers, architects, engineers, QA teams, and delivery partners.

- Lead product discovery, refinement, sprint planning, reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives; make timely scope decisions and resolve product questions throughout delivery.

- Prioritize D1 and D2 enhancements within available capacity and build business cases, estimates, dependencies, and delivery plans for larger D3 initiatives or separately funded projects.

- Own business readiness and user acceptance, coordinate business testers, approve release content, and ensure defects, dependencies, training, communications, support procedures, and rollback plans are addressed before go-live.

**Web Technology, Integration and Product Quality:**

- Provide informed product direction across modern web architectures and technologies, including React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Java Spring Boot, .NET, PHP, SQL, responsive design, headless content management, and cloud-hosted services.

- Understand and challenge solution designs covering frontend components, backend services, API contracts, data flows, authentication, content delivery, caching, scalability, resilience, and environment or release dependencies.

- Guide product requirements for Contentful, Drupal, WordPress, and other approved content platforms, including content models, workflows, localization, governance, performance, and reusable content across web experiences.

- Coordinate integrations with Salesforce, Oracle ERP, enterprise middleware, payment platforms, digital identity, DocuSign, marketing and analytics tools, and other upstream or downstream systems; ensure ownership of dependencies and data-quality issues.

- Define and enforce non-functional requirements for availability, performance, Core Web Vitals, latency, security, privacy, accessibility, browser compatibility, search visibility, observability, recoverability, and maintainability.

- Work with technical teams to maintain effective CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, deployment controls, rollback procedures, coding standards, technical documentation, and secure development practices.

- Use New Relic, AWS CloudWatch, Pingdom, analytics platforms, and other approved tools to monitor customer journeys, application and API performance, errors, availability, and release impact.

**Operations and Partner Service Governance:**

- Act as the accountable product owner for web service outcomes and govern Cognizant and other partners delivering functional analysis, UX, development, QA, DevOps, monitoring, technical support, and content operations.

- Ensure incidents, service requests, performance degradations, content issues, and recurring defects are prioritized and resolved through the agreed L1.5, L2, and L3 support model and ITSM processes.

- Review SLA and KPI performance, incident trends, root-cause analyses, problem records, support volumes, knowledge articles, release quality, partner capacity, and continuous-improvement actions.

- Provide product leadership during priority incidents, coordinate business communications and technical escalation, approve acceptable workarounds, and ensure permanent corrective actions are implemented and verified.

- Run regular product, delivery, and service reviews; address missed commitments, quality gaps, unresolved dependencies, technical debt, and risks with clear owners and deadlines.

**Analytics, Optimization and Stakeholder Leadership:**

- Define the measurement framework for web products, including traffic quality, property discovery, search and content engagement, lead conversion, funnel drop-off, task completion, owner self-service, customer satisfaction, availability, and performance.

- Use analytics, experimentation, user feedback, service data, and market insight to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, optimize journeys, and demonstrate product value.

- Maintain an executive view of roadmap progress, delivery confidence, realized benefits, adoption, customer outcomes, operational health, material risks, and decisions required.

- Build strong relationships across business and technology teams, balancing near-term commercial priorities with customer trust, platform health, security, architectural integrity, and long-term product sustainability.

**Skills and Abilities:**

- Strong knowledge of real-estate and PropTech customer journeys, including property discovery, lead generation, sales conversion, buyer onboarding, handover, ownership, resident services, and post-sale engagement.

- Strong working knowledge of web frontend and backend technologies, APIs, cloud platforms, headless CMS, data flows, integration patterns, CI/CD, testing, security, monitoring, and production support.

- Practical understanding of React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Java Spring Boot, .NET or PHP, Contentful, Drupal or WordPress, Azure or AWS, and enterprise integrations; hands-on coding is not required, but technical depth is essential.

**Minimum Requirements:**

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Product Management, Marketing, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

- Minimum of 8-12 years of experience in digital products, business technology, or customer experience, including at least 5 years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or equivalent leader for customer-facing web platforms.

- Demonstrated real-estate, property-development, property-portal, community-management, or PropTech domain experience is required, with a strong understanding of prospective buyer and property-owner journeys.

- Experience owning high-traffic websites or portals across strategy, discovery, delivery, launch, analytics, optimization, and live operations.

- Experience working with multidisciplinary teams covering product analysis, UX/UI, frontend, backend, APIs, QA, DevOps, cloud, architecture, security, data, and service operations.

- Experience managing offshore or managed-service delivery partners and operating within Agile, ITIL, demand-management, change, release, incident, and problem-management processes.

- Product Owner or Agile certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe POPM, or equivalent are preferred; UX, analytics, or digital-marketing certifications are an advantage.

description:
**Job Description**
We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.
  
  
As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank Payments Technology team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Develops secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
* Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and systems
* Leads evaluation sessions with external vendors, startups, and internal teams to drive outcomes-oriented probing of architectural designs, technical credentials, and applicability for use within existing systems and information architecture

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Java and Spring Boot
* Microservice design: service boundaries, API contracts and versioning, idempotency, and resilience (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers).
* Oracle and JPA performance: N+1 queries, indexing, connection pools, transaction boundaries, and Liquibase migration strategy with rollback.
* Observability and production ownership: SLOs, alerting, tracing, and incident and root-cause leadership.
* Testing and quality gates: unit, integration and contract tests, with coverage and Sonar standards. Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Advanced in one or more programming language(s)
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Trade finance and architecture: Trade finance domain knowledge; event-driven design with Kafka or MQ and the outbox pattern.
* Frontend and data: React/TypeScript, Salt design system, micro-frontends behind the proxy, and modern alternatives to Jasper for reporting and analytics.
* Cloud-native delivery: AWS or private cloud, Terraform/IaC, Docker, Kubernetes/Kustomize, CI/CD, blue-green or canary deployments, and multi-environment configuration.
* Resilience and performance: Load testing, capacity planning, DR and BCP design, and multi-region or active-active setups.
* Security, AI, and cost: OAuth2/OIDC/ADFS, JWT, session management, least privilege, OWASP, secrets handling, CVE/FARM remediation and dependency currency; governed use of Copilot-style tools; FinOps and cost optimisation.

**ABOUT US**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

* Experience leading development teams, code reviews, mentoring and technical decision-making.

* Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana and Splunk.

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. We are looking for a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of enterprise-scale AI platforms, knowledge graph systems, and intelligent applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in distributed systems, scalable software architecture, knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and production-grade AI engineering.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enterprise Knowledge Graph Engineering
* Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise knowledge graph platforms.
* Build knowledge ingestion, entity extraction, relationship mapping, entity resolution, and graph enrichment pipelines.
* Design graph data models, ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic relationships.
* Develop high-performance graph querying, retrieval, and reasoning capabilities.
* Integrate knowledge graphs with enterprise data sources, applications, and AI systems.
* Implement GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval, and context-aware search architectures.
* Ensure scalability, reliability, data consistency, and performance of graph-based systems.

* Lead the architecture and development of production-grade AI applications leveraging Large Language Models.
* Design and implement RAG, GraphRAG, agentic AI, and intelligent workflow solutions.
* Integrate and orchestrate multiple proprietary and open-source LLMs, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and other emerging models.
* Evaluate LLM capabilities, reasoning quality, latency, context handling, accuracy, cost, and suitability for different use cases.
* Develop model-agnostic architectures enabling flexible model selection, routing, and fallback strategies.
* Optimize prompt engineering, context management, inference performance, token consumption, and operational costs.
* Build LLM evaluation frameworks, monitoring, guardrails, and observability capabilities.
* Address hallucinations, retrieval quality, grounding, security, and reliability challenges in enterprise AI applications.
* Scalable Systems Architecture
* Architect highly scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems supporting enterprise workloads.
* Design cloud-native, microservices-based, asynchronous, and event-driven architectures.
* Build high-throughput data pipelines and low-latency APIs.
* Drive performance engineering, horizontal scaling, caching, concurrency, and infrastructure optimization.
* Design secure, multi-tenant systems with robust isolation and enterprise-grade availability.
* Make architectural trade-offs across performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost.
* Production Engineering & Platform Reliability
* Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to production deployment and ongoing maintenance.
* Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident management.
* Implement observability, distributed tracing, performance monitoring, and operational diagnostics.
* Drive system reliability, availability, security, and operational excellence.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed systems, graph databases, and LLM integrations.
* Continuously improve scalability, response times, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs.
* Technical Leadership
* Provide technical direction and architectural leadership across engineering teams.
* Lead complex system design discussions, architecture reviews, and technology evaluations.
* Mentor senior engineers and establish strong software engineering practices.
* Collaborate with product, AI/ML, data engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.
* Translate complex enterprise requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Take ownership of critical architectural decisions and long-term platform evolution.
* Remain hands-on with design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and performance optimization.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Go, or equivalent backend programming languages.
* Demonstrated experience architecting, developing, and maintaining enterprise-scale software platforms.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying knowledge graph or graph-based data systems.
* Strong understanding of graph databases, graph algorithms, semantic modeling, and knowledge retrieval.
* Practical experience building production AI applications using LLMs.
* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers and understanding model-specific capabilities, limitations, and engineering trade-offs.
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and hybrid retrieval.
* Expertise in cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with microservices, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, and distributed data processing.
* Strong knowledge of system design, scalability, concurrency, reliability, and performance optimization.
* Proven ability to independently drive complex engineering initiatives from design to production.

**Preferred Technical Experience**
Knowledge Graph & Data Technologies
  
  

* Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, RDF, SPARQL, Cypher
* Ontology Modeling, Entity Resolution, Graph Algorithms
* Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Graph Databases
* Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector

Generative AI & LLM Frameworks
  
  

* OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Llama, Mistral
* LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph
* GraphRAG, Agentic RAG, Hybrid RAG
* Embedding Models, Reranking, Semantic Search
* Model Context Protocol (MCP), Tool Calling
* LLM Evaluation, Observability, Guardrails

Scalable Architecture & Infrastructure
  
  

* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL
* Distributed Systems, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture
* CI/CD, Monitoring, Distributed Tracing
* High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Performance Engineering

What Makes an Ideal Candidate
  
  
**We Are Particularly Interested In Engineers Who**

* Have built and operated real enterprise-scale systems, not just prototypes or proof-of-concepts.
* Have designed knowledge graph platforms and solved real-world challenges around ingestion, retrieval, graph performance, and scalability.
* Understand the nuances of different LLMs and know when and why to use a particular model.
* Have experience taking AI applications from experimentation to secure, reliable, cost-efficient production deployments.
* Can operate comfortably across AI engineering, backend systems, data architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
* Are strong hands-on engineers who can influence architecture and engineering practices across multiple teams.
* Demonstrate deep technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to solve ambiguous, complex engineering problems.

Success in This Role
  
  
**Success Will Be Measured By The Ability To**

* Deliver robust and scalable knowledge graph and AI platform capabilities.
* Improve platform performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Accelerate the development and production deployment of enterprise AI applications.
* Establish reusable architectural patterns and engineering standards.
* Reduce technical complexity and improve long-term platform maintainability.
* Enable engineering teams to deliver complex AI solutions with greater speed and quality.
